description: This Java class 'ServiceXaWrapper' is an XA resource wrapper for managing transactional service calls with commit and rollback capabilities, including asynchronous execution and transaction suspension/resumption.

classes.name: ServiceXaWrapper
classes.description: A deprecated Java class implementing XAResource for transactional service execution with support for commit, rollback, and asynchronous processing.

methods.name: setCommitService
methods.description: Configures the service to execute on transaction commit with optional user and context.

methods.name: getCommitService
methods.description: Returns the name of the service configured for commit.

methods.name: setRollbackService
methods.description: Configures the service to execute on transaction rollback with optional user and context.

methods.name: getRollbackService
methods.description: Returns the name of the service configured for rollback.

methods.name: enlist
methods.description: Enlists the resource in the current transaction, with verbose logging.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Performs commit operation by running the configured commit service asynchronously.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Performs rollback operation by running the configured rollback service asynchronously.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the transaction for two-phase commit, with verbose logging.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Executes a service call within a managed transaction, suspending and resuming transactions as needed, supporting async and sync modes.
